notes.title: v1.0.26　Fix for a critical bug
notes.notes:
I have fixed a bug where, after selecting "Continue" from the title screen and resuming the game from a saved file, the door would not open even after capturing the anomaly.

This was a critical bug, as it effectively rendered the save function unusable. I sincerely apologize to all players who encountered this issue.

In future games, I will take extra care to create more thorough test scenarios and ensure proper test play so that issues like this will be minimized.

Due to this change, the total number of anomalies captured may display a value that is 2 more than the maximum number of anomalies (72), resulting in a potential total of 74. This issue is planned to be fixed eventually.

notes.title: v1.0.18 - Update
notes.notes:
In this update, one new achievement has been added. Apologies to those who have already played. This achievement is related to Anomaly 47.

- Added a legend to the hint signboard. Some players misunderstood the hint as being for the *next* floor's anomaly, so I added a legend to indicate that the hint actually refers to the anomaly on the *previous* floor, reducing such misunderstandings.
- For the camera focus mark, I previously only changed its color after a photo was captured, but now I've updated it to display a check icon upon success. This change makes it easier for players to understand what happened, especially for first-time players.
- Revised settings to prevent difficult anomalies from appearing early in the game.
- Made minor adjustments to the staff credits.
- Corrected some translations in Chinese.




■Anomalies
- [Anomaly 3] Increased speed, adjusted the expansion pattern, and expanded the area where the player can be affected.
- [Anomaly 4] Adjusted the final state.
- [Anomaly 21] Enhanced the visual effects.
- [Anomaly 47] Added an achievement.
- [Anomaly 54] Made minor adjustments to the world restart effect.
- [Anomaly 56] Made minor adjustments to the visual effects.
